query_analysis.original_query: We’re troubleshooting an amine system in a gas sweetening process. Our H2S levels in the treated gas are spiking intermittently. What could cause this inconsistency?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Investigate and diagnose the root causes of intermittent H2S spikes in the treated gas of an amine-based gas sweetening process.

communication_strategy.information_flow: Collaborative data analysis and hypothesis testing
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Iterative problem-solving with real-time data sharing

clarification_questions: What is the frequency and duration of the H2S spikes?
Are there any changes in the amine solution or process conditions during the spikes?
Have you checked for any potential equipment malfunctions or leaks?
